Name: SOUNDID_SPATIAL_SETTING
Description: Spatial (reverb) settings for specific sounds: each row names a sound by type and number and sets its reverberation level.

Fields.Name: Target Sound ID: Type
Fields.Description: Type part of the sound ID this row applies to.

Fields.Name: Target Sound ID: Number
Fields.Description: Number part of the sound ID this row applies to.

Fields.Name: Reverb Level
Fields.Description: Reverberation (echo) level applied to the target sound.
